subjects.label: Rage and broken controllers
subjects.description: The game as a source of fury: smashed pads, punched walls, strokes, stress and cats thrown out of windows after a loss, whether the player is laughing about it or not; ordinary dislike of the game without the rage does not belong here.

subjects.label: Same game as last year
subjects.description: Whether this year's entry differs from the previous one: copy and paste, the same as the last instalment, the same thing every year, or the worst-feeling instalment yet; comparisons with games outside the series belong under genre instead.

subjects.label: Career mode
subjects.description: Career mode as its own subject: transfers in player career, regens, a bug that infects every new career, and how little the mode changes from year to year; talk of the online card mode belongs under Ultimate Team.

subjects.label: Ultimate Team and pack luck
subjects.description: The card mode and its economy: pack pulls, drop rates, buying points, objectives, promo cards and the weekend league; general grumbling about microtransactions with no mention of the mode stays under monetisation.

subjects.label: Shooting and goalkeepers
subjects.description: How shots and keepers behave: power shots into the top corner, a hard shot always saved in a one on one while a soft roll goes through the keeper's legs, and shooting dynamics judged pointless; other on-pitch mechanics stay under gameplay.

subjects.label: Real-world club fandom
subjects.description: Reviews used to cheer or curse a real club, player, chairman or match rather than to discuss the game: a cup final report, prayers for a relegation escape, a club slogan, a demand that a president resign; which teams and players the game includes belongs under licensing.

subjects.label: Support tickets and bans
subjects.description: Dealing with the publisher's support desk: tickets unanswered for months, a ban handed out with no reason given, appeals answered by bots, and a long-known bug the publisher never acknowledges; patches and roadmaps stay under updates.
